author: official
summary: Opens an animated QR code for a URL from a Cardtile-rendered icon.

attributes.name: data-url
attributes.description: URL encoded in the QR matrix.

attributes.name: data-name
attributes.description: Name shown above the QR code.

attributes.name: data-version
attributes.description: QR version override; zero or a pinned version too small for the URL falls back to automatic selection.

requirements: Cardtile-only renderer output, not a standalone copy-paste embed. Cardtile supplies page CSS and the coral script. Requires a child .cp-icon and Cardtile CSS variables --cp-ground, --cp-accent, --r-lg, --s-4.
